IDENT.title: ML2MAS: a multi-agent reinforcement learning and BNNs-GAN integration framework for smart manufacturing optimization

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No formal agent definition; MAS described as autonomous agents interacting with each other and environment.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: Multi-agent systems (MAS) consist of autonomous agents that inter- act with each other and their environment to perform distributed tasks.
